A '''personalized form of martial arts''' was developed by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Desolous]]. The style combined the usage of a [[Cortosis shield/Legends|cortosis shield]] and a melee weapon. Desolous personally trained an [[Darth Desolous's army|army]] of [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] warriors in his combat style, and they later employed the martial art in Desolous's [[Darth Desolous conflict|fight]] against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Following Desolous's [[Death/Legends|death]], a simulacrum of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] was created by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to serve as an opponent in the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]]. The simulacrum fought in the same style as the real Desolous.

==Description==
Developed by the [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]-turned-[[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Desolous]], the style combined [[Cortosis shield/Legends|cortosis shields]] and melee weapons. The shield was typically used to block an opponent's attack and leave the enemy open to a swift counterattack. As the shield was made from the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-resistant [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]], it was effective even against the traditional weapon of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].<ref name="TFU databank" />

==History==
At some point after [[3522 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Desolous developed his own form of martial arts. After he was expelled from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for studying [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings, Desolous trained an [[Darth Desolous's army|army]] of Pau'ans in his fighting style and employed them in a [[Darth Desolous conflict|series of strikes]] against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Desolous and his followers [[Death/Legends|slew]] almost two thousand Jedi, until they were in turn killed during a [[Battle of Yaga Minor (Darth Desolous conflict)|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]].<ref name="TFU databank" />

Later, a simulacrum of Darth Desolous was created by the Jedi as part of the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]], a series of challenges that Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] faced in order to become Jedi Knights.<ref name="TFU databank" /> The simulated figure fought in the style developed by the real Desolous, using a cortosis shield in conjunction with a red-bladed lightsaber. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the simulacrum [[Starkiller's Trial of Skill|fought]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]] and employed the technique in combat, but was defeated by him.<ref name="TFU">{{TFU|version=[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PS2]] and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Desolous's martial arts style is mentioned in Desolous's databank entry in the [[Krome Studios]]-developed [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]], [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]], and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]] versions of the [[2008]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''.<ref name="TFU databank" /> Its description is consistent with the style employed by the simulacrum of Desolous in the game itself.<ref name="TFU" /> [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'': Prima Official Game Guide]] also indirectly mentions this style in its warning to players that Desolous is capable of launching a quick counterattack.<ref name="TFU Guide">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
